answer_1.quote: Users receive text responses from randomly sampled systems and provide pairwise preferences with qualitative feedback.
answer_1.outputs: text responses to user audio queries

answer_2.quote: For classification tasks, we report macro F1 scores to account for the importance of different classes due to class imbalance in some datasets. We compute PEDANTS score for tasks requiring a short text response using the questions and reference answers. For ASR tasks, we report the Word Error Rate (WER).

answer_4.quote: we collect 7,500 interactions between 484 paid participants (all with prior commercial LLM chat experience) and 6 speech-in text-out systems... users provide pairwise preferences with qualitative feedback.
answer_4.guideline: Choose the better response between two models or indicate a tie, and optionally provide a justification.
